answer: Require every new identity to arrive through a narrow inlet: credentials from three independent issuer classes — a bank, a university, and a telecom — which never share data. The network accepts the identity only when all three attestations check out, and any issuer caught selling attestations loses its slot. A lone island of fake accounts can forge one issuer's stamp, but not three independent ones at scale: each extra puppet needs three separate corruptions, so attacker cost triples per identity, while an honest user pays once, on a ledge the farm cannot cheaply climb.
